assets.description: Discover (list) and download the media assets attached to a movie: thumbnail, cover, preview images and the preview video. This command does not download full movies or magnets.
assets.download_description: Download movie assets from TYPE<TAB>URL records piped by `javdb assets list`. -d places auto-named files (image-001.jpg, video-001.mp4) into DIR; -o writes a single asset to an exact path (.ts keeps the transport stream, .mp4 produces a fast-start MP4). Existing files are never overwritten. Output is the final written path per line.
assets.invalid_input_type: invalid input at line %d: unsupported asset type %q
assets.list_description: List the media assets of a movie: thumbnail, cover, preview images and preview video. Optional selectors are 1-based positions in the current (filtered) list, e.g. 1, 1-4, 1,3-5, or several: 1 3 5. Without a selector every asset of the requested type is listed. JSON/NDJSON always contain type/url and add best-effort width/height/duration metadata when available. Pipe output remains TYPE<TAB>URL per line and feeds `javdb assets download`.

completion.bash.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(javdb completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	javdb completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/javdb

#### macOS:

	javdb completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/javdb

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
completion.bash.short: Generate the autocompletion script for bash
completion.fish.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	javdb completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	javdb completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/javdb.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
completion.fish.short: Generate the autocompletion script for fish

completion.powershell.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	javdb completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.
completion.powershell.short: Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
completion.short: Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
completion.zsh.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(javdb completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	javdb completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_javdb"

#### macOS:

	javdb completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_javdb

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
